source.query:
SELECT
UUID,
Data_Year,
Data_Month,
BU_Cd,
BU_NmCn,
BU_NmEn,
KPI_Cd,
KPI_Nm,
Value_Month,
Value_YTD,
Etl_Time
FROM dscc.Wave2_DM_FACT_GCR_SC
WHERE dt=trunc(current_timestamp,'MM')

select t1.* from dscc.Wave2_DM_FACT_Nestle_Order_Overview t1
where t1.KPIDate >= add_months(trunc(to_date(current_date()),'MM'), -1)
